    • readDeckCards

      List<DeckCard> readDeckCards(String filePath, int numPlayers)

      reads the deck cards from the specified file path and builds a list of DeckCards

      Parameters:
      filePath - not null, path of the file where the deck cards data is stored
      numPlayers - the initial number of players in the game, used to determine which cards to read from the file
      Returns:
      a list of DeckCard objects read from the specified file path, sorted by number of players

    • readTrackCards

      Map<Character, TrackCard> readTrackCards(String filePath, int numPlayers)

      reads the track cards from the specified file path and builds a map of TrackCard objects, where the keys are the track card names and the values are the corresponding TrackCard objects

      Parameters:
      filePath - not null, path of the file where the track cards data is stored
      numPlayers - the initial number of players in the game, used to determine which track cards to read from the file
      Returns:
      a map of TrackCard objects read from the specified file path, where the keys are the TrackCard names, sorted alphabetically
